description: Where tests/vendor/openapi-2.20.0.json came from, so the committed copy can be checked against the vendor's artifact. The JSON is the vendor's YAML converted by the Ruby line below; it is test input, the baseline the drift check compares an upstream file against, and the source the committed extract is regenerated from.
license: Apache-2.0 (stated in the file's info block)
conversion: ruby -ryaml -rjson -rdate -e 'doc = YAML.safe_load(File.read(ARGV[0]), permitted_classes: [Date, Time], aliases: false); File.write(ARGV[1], JSON.generate(doc))' anchore_api_swagger.yaml openapi-2.20.0.json
